_comment: device_id -> simulatable model handle. provenance mirrors the catalog's brick-risk vocabulary: founder-verified | community-reported | llm-inferred | proxy. 'proxy' means parametric primitive bodies (honest 'proxy dynamics'), not a scanned model. Phase 1 ships proxies for the diff-drive slice; real MJCF/URDF models slot in later under the same keys.

irobot-create-3.notes: iRobot Create 3 round diff-drive base. Dimensions from public spec sheet; treated as proxy dynamics.

turtlebot4.notes: TurtleBot 4 sits on a Create 3 base.

default_diff_drive.notes: Generic parametric diff-drive proxy used when no device-specific model is registered.
